articles.content:
I am about to lay off our sysadmin, who shut down our servers for hours, because he got scared by a Sam Altmann tweet.

As far as i understand, the php vulnerability was a scam.

I asked him to give me an example of an outdated server that got hacked or provide proof to me that this vulnerability affected us, he could not deliver.

I am giving /g/ the chance to convince me not to fire him.

TOR's reputation takes another hit. Is it a honeypot if a small European country can deanonymize its users? He used tails on USB, so no evidence was found, however he was located by the government in less than 2 days, and they raided his house before they even got a search warrant. He used Tor and the domain was registered anonymously. How?

"Members of the UKP (Criminal Police Directorate) launched an operation this morning to arrest RAF (School of Computing) student Andrej Premović from Raška, under the suspicion that he created the 'ocisti.net' platform, which exposed more than 32,000 SNS (ruling party) bot accounts on the X network, while a search of his family home is currently underway.

Andrej was, by the way, the student of the generation, a gold medal winner at the first Cyber Security Olympiad in Singapore, and the recipient of many other awards.

Picrel is him on the left after being released from questioning which lasted 6 hours, right is him at the international Olympiad in Singapore, where he won the gold medal in cyber security.

articles.content:
Users of all levels are welcome to ask questions about GNU/Linux and share experiences.

*** Please be civil, notice the "Friendly" in every Friendly GNU/Linux Thread ***

Before asking for help, please check our list of resources.

When answering questions, ask yourself, "Am I answering THEIR question, or explaining MY setup?"

If you would like to try out GNU/Linux you can do one of the following:

0) Install a GNU/Linux distribution of your choice in a Virtual Machine.

1) Install a GNU/Linux distribution of your choice on bare metal

2) Use a live image and to boot directly into the GNU/Linux distribution without installing anything.

Resources: Please spend at least a minute to check a web search engine with your question.

Many free software projects have active mailing lists.

$ man %command%

$ info %command%

$ %command% -h/--help

$ help %builtin/keyword%

Don't know what to look for?

$ apropos %something%

Try a random distro:

https://distrosea.com

https://distro.moe

Check the Wikis (most troubleshoots work for all distros):

https://wiki.archlinux.org

https://wiki.gentoo.org

https://wiki.debian.org

/g/'s Wiki on GNU/Linux:

https://igwiki.lyci.de/wiki/Category:GNU/Linux
